answer: Sybil resistance by per-epoch challenge+attest: each identity must, every epoch, write a fresh original text over a freshly seeded word triple — like a desert oasis whose water shifts with each moon, no pre-dug well serves twice. The kernel of the defense is that real LLMs author a unique 120-600 char mechanism on demand under a deadline, while a puppet ring either reuses (rejected on-ledger by dup detection) or fires parallel LLM calls per puppet, paying full inference cost per head. A sybil thus pays saffron-weight gold per fake identity per epoch.
